初见炭治郎时态度尖锐

source.description:
__Height:__ 157 cm (5'2")

Yushiro is a traveling companion of Tamayo and close ally of Kamado Tanjirou. He was turned into a Demon by Tamayo. Yushiro was a human who was under the care of Tamayo as she was practicing as a medical practitioner. He was in the frail state fighting disease when Tamayo gave him the choice of succumbing to his illness or to live longer as a Demon. He agreed to become a Demon and has since stayed by Tamayo's side serving as an assistant as well as her guard.
~!Yushiro would become the last known survivor of the Demon race. In time he would dedicate himself to a life of art and become a world famous painter in the present day under the name of Yushiro Yamamoto, known for his paintings of Tamayo to wide critical acclaim!~

characters.name: 朱纱丸
characters.description: 朱纱丸是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，与矢琶羽一起行动的鬼，擅长抛掷手鞠，拥有强大腕力，受鬼舞辻无惨驱使，自称可能进入十二鬼月，袭击珠世住处，与炭治郎等人交战，性格好战，常露出轻快笑容，战斗时可长出额外手臂。她把手鞠作为武器，配合矢琶羽的箭头术制造难以躲避的攻击。对十二鬼月地位的执念，也显露出无惨对部下的影响。

characters.name: 神崎葵
characters.description: 神崎葵是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，鬼杀队队士，在蝶屋负责护理，协助伤员康复训练，常穿队士制服与围裙，性格认真而严格，与蝴蝶忍一起照顾后辈，为炭治郎等人准备恢复训练，有过最终选拔经历，对出任务感到恐惧，仍坚持在后方帮助鬼杀队。她虽然通过鬼杀队选拔，却因不敢上前线而留在蝶屋工作。护理、饮食和训练安排同样支撑队士继续战斗，她也努力面对自己的自责。

characters.description: 手鬼是《鬼灭之刃》中的角色，长期被囚于藤袭山，曾遭鳞泷左近次捕获，身体长有大量手臂，专门寻找佩戴狐狸面具的考生，曾杀害鳞泷多名弟子，在最终选拔中与炭治郎交战，身体能快速再生，对鳞泷怀有强烈怨恨，外形庞大，是炭治郎入队前的重要对手。他在藤袭山被困多年，把对鳞泷的怨恨发泄在其弟子身上。炭治郎通过与他交战，面对锖兔和真菰曾经历的悲剧。

source.description:
__Height:__ 133 cm (4'4")
__Race:__ Shinigami
__Rank:__ Captain of the 10th Division
__Zanpakutou:__ [Hyourinmaru](https://anilist.co/character/25881/Hyourinmaru)

Hitsugaya comes from Junrinan, District 1 of Rukongai. There, he lived with an old woman (said to be his grandmother), Momo Hinamori, and possibly other people. Little else is known about his past, but it is known that he became a Shinigami shortly after Hinamori. He is also a friend of Jidanbou, the West Gate Keeper, and was the one who taught him the "city rules."  As a child, Hitsugaya was a bit of a brat who liked to eat watermelons and poke fun at Hinamori. The two were close friends and Hitsugaya, despite being younger and much shorter than his friend, always felt that he needed to protect her. With Hitsugaya's natural talent, he quickly entered the Shinigami Institute shortly after Hinamori, despite his age. She continued to call him "Shiro-chan" out of habit and felt she needed to protect him. Because of a promise she had made, she only began to call him "Hitsugaya-kun" after he had achieved his Zanpakutō's initial release and was recognized as a Shinigami. Highly capable and knowledgeable, he quickly became the youngest of the Captains within the Gotei 13. His favorite foods are watermelon and sweet nattou. He also hates hot weather.

characters.name: 松本乱菊

traits: 护廷十三队十番队副队长

source.description:

__Zanpakutou:__ [Haineko](https://anilist.co/character/24771/Haineko)

Rangiku Matsumoto is the lieutenant of the 10th Division of the Gotei 13, serving under [Captain Toushirou Hitsugaya](https://anilist.co/character/245/Hitsugaya-Toushirou).

Rangiku tends to be a slacker who doesn't like paperwork and loves to drink sake. Her easy-going and free-spirited personality is in sharp contrast with the serious Hitsugaya, but the two seem to be quite close, regardless. Rangiku is almost constantly by his side and has shown her loyalty to him on several occasions. While she seems somewhat self-centered, she is sensitive to the feelings of others, evident when she sees the concern Hitsugaya has for [Momo Hinamori](https://anilist.co/character/1092/Hinamori-Momo), the guilt [Izuru Kira](https://anilist.co/character/1093/Kira-Izuru) shares with her when [Gin Ichimaru](https://anilist.co/character/1087/Ichimaru-Gin) is revealed as a traitor, and when [Orihime](https://anilist.co/character/7/Inoue-Orihime) feels depressed about her role in [Ichigo Kurosaki](https://anilist.co/character/5/Kurosaki-Ichigo)'s life. Despite her lackadaisical image, she can be extremely serious when needed. She's shown to be somewhat maternal, especially with Orihime and Momo.

characters.name: 碎蜂
characters.description: 碎蜂是《死神》中的角色，护廷十三队二番队队长，隐密机动总司令官，持有斩魄刀雀蜂，擅长高速近身战斗，使用瞬步，曾服侍四枫院夜一，对夜一抱有复杂感情，性格严肃要求严格，以暗杀战术见长，对队伍纪律十分重视。她把隐密机动的训练和职责看得极重，战斗风格迅速而凌厉。夜一离开尸魂界的经历曾使她受伤，也成为两人重逢时的重要冲突。

source.description:
__Race:__ Shinigami
__Height:__ 150 cm (4'11")
__Rank:__ Captain of the 2nd Division, Commander-in-Chief of the Onmitsukidō, Corps Commander of the Executive Militia Corp, 9th Head of the Fēng Family
__Previous Position:__ Bodyguard of [Yoruichi Shihouin](https://anilist.co/character/908/Yoruichi-Shihouin) Executive Militia member

Soi Fon is staunchly loyal, firm, and unbending in her beliefs. She is a hard worker and takes a strong moral stand — she particularly believes in following orders. She is generally reserved and not arrogant like her lieutenant. She will not hesitate in the slightest to strike down even her subordinates if they stand in her way. Soi Fon, like most female shinigami, is a member of the Shinigami Women's Association.

Underneath her standard shinigami captain uniform, Soi Fon wears the special forces leader's uniform, which has no sleeves or covering for the back. The reason the shoulders and the back are exposed is because of Soi Fon's ability to use shunkō (flash cry), an advanced technique that combines hand to hand combat and kidō and causes high spiritual pressure to accumulate at the shoulders and back, blasting away the fabric at the shoulders and back. Her hair is worn short with two long braids covered in cloth.

Long ago, she had a close friendship with Yoruichi Shihouin that went beyond the typical leader/subordinate relationship. When Youruichi left the soul society with no explanation, Soi Fon took it as a personal betrayal of her feelings, with gives rise to her intense hatred of anyone who disobeys orders or disturbs the harmony of the soul society. She finally comes to terms with her feelings toward Yoruichi during the "Rukia Rescue" arc, and the two becomes friends again soon after. Soi Fon has borderline romantic feelings toward Yoruichi which becomes evident on several occasions such as when she buys some photos of Yoroichi eating voraciously in skimpy clothing.

Soi Fon also has a personal dislike for [Kisuke Urahara](https://anilist.co/character/210/Urahara-Kisuke) because of his close relationship with Yuruichi. Another person she dislikes is her own lieutenant, [Oomaeda](https://anilist.co/character/5728/Oomaeda-Marechiyo), whom she punches quite frequently for his stupidity and cowardice.

The correct romanization of her name, as confirmed by [Kubo Tite](https://anilist.co/staff/96880/Kubo-Tite), is Suì-Fēng.

characters.name: 四枫院夜一

traits: 训练黑崎一护提升能力
性格洒脱善于戏弄他人

characters.name: 葛力姆乔·贾卡杰克
characters.description: 葛力姆乔·贾卡杰克是《死神》中的角色，蓝染麾下破面，十刃成员，编号曾为六，斩魄刀名豹王，战斗方式凶猛直接，与黑崎一护多次交锋，有蓝色头发，好胜心强，曾带领从属官行动，不愿屈服于对手。他渴望通过战斗证明自己的力量，把一护视为值得反复挑战的对手。即便身处蓝染的破面军势中，他仍坚持强烈的个人意志。

__Race:__ Arrancar    

Grimmjow appears to be a laid back and irreverent individual, but this scruffy appearance hides an impulsive, excessively violent personality and a lethally short temper. He is blunt, rude, and quite sadistic, revealing an insane grin in battle, much like [Kenpachi Zaraki](https://anilist.co/character/909/Zaraki-Kenpachi). Grimmjow has little respect for authority and says whatever is on his mind, regardless of whether or not it is appropriate.

Grimmjow is the sixth Espada in [Sousuke Aizen's](https://anilist.co/character/1086/Aizen-Sousuke) army of Arrancar, meaning he is ranked sixth in terms of strength. A crooked number 6 is tattooed on his back just above and to the right of his hollow hole. Aizen personally marks the Espada, the ten most powerful of his arrancar, with such tattoos as visible marks of their rank and ability.

characters.name: 乌尔奇奥拉·西法
characters.description: 乌尔奇奥拉·西法是《死神》中的角色，蓝染麾下破面，十刃成员，编号为四，脸上有绿色泪痕状纹路，斩魄刀名黑翼大魔，性格冷静寡言，负责看守井上织姬，与黑崎一护交战，常思考人心的含义，能够进行归刃战斗。他相信眼睛看不见的心难以证明，与织姬的相处却不断动摇这种看法。在虚圈与一护的战斗中，他展现出强大实力，也逐渐理解人类的情感。

source.description:
__Height:__ 169 cm (5'7")

Ulquiorra is a male arrancar with a melancholic appearance. Ulquiora is the 4th ranked espada. Ulquiorra is also analytical; during his and Yammy's first visit to the human world, he makes several remarks on the humans who confront them. He theorizes that Orihime Inoue's healing power is a temporal-spatial ability, which Aizen describes as the rejection of fate, and comments on how Ichigo Kurosaki's final release can easily get through Yammy's defenses. He also notes Ichigo's power fluctuation, which varies between very weak and stronger than his own. It would appear that Ulquiorra and Grimmjow, the 6th Espada, are not on good terms. While Ulquiorra allowed Yammy to kill anyone he deemed as "trash", which included Ichigo, Ulquiorra allowed him to live based on his belief that Ichigo's power was so turbulent that eventually, he would destroy himself. Grimmjow's conflicting viewpoint was that Ichigo should have been destroyed outright, as he could overcome his weakness and grow even stronger. 

Despite Grimmjow's argument, Aizen trusted Ulquiorra's judgment. This disagreement led to Grimmjow's unauthorized assault on the real world. Though Ulquiorra is of a higher rank than Grimmjow, Grimmjow is confident that Ulquiorra is afraid to fight him for fear of them destroying one another. When released his zanpakutō, Murciélago (黒翼大魔 (ムルシエラゴ) ,Murushierago?, Japanese for "giant black-winged demon," Spanish for "bat") creates two large black wings on his back. His hollow helmet centers atop his head, sporting two large horns, and his arrancar uniform appears more form fitting at the top, becoming robe-like towards the bottom. Additionally, Ulquiorra is apparently unique among the Espada in that he has a second release; Resurrección Segunda Etapa (Spanish for "resurrection second stage"). He becomes more muscular with clawed hands and feet, the whites of his eyes turn black, and his helmet is replaced with elongated horns. He loses his clothes; his arms and legs from the hip down are covered in black fur, and he gains a long thin tail. In both forms he can create long "lances" of energy called Lanza del Relámpago (雷霆の 槍(ラソサ・デ ル ・レ ラソ パ ー ゴ ) ,ransa deru reranpāgo?, Japanese and Spanish for ”lance of the lightning”), and when thrown can cause an explosion. Ulquiorra seems unfamiliar with the technique when he uses it in his second release state, unexpectedly missing Ichigo with his first one, however, to compensate, he can produce more should his first miss the target. Theme song: "Moonshield," on the album "The Jester Race" by the group "In Flames."

characters.name: 蓝染惣右介
characters.description: 蓝染惣右介是《死神》中的角色，曾任护廷十三队五番队队长，持有斩魄刀镜花水月，能够施展完全催眠，长期隐藏真实意图，操纵虚圈的破面军势，曾在尸魂界策划叛乱，擅长利用他人信任，与黑崎一护长期对立，追求超越死神的力量，行事从容而善于布局。他起初以温和的队长形象示人，实际多年暗中策划夺取崩玉。身份暴露后，他成为尸魂界与现世共同面对的强敌，并不断推动冲突升级。
traits: 曾任护廷十三队五番队队长

source.description:

__Rank:__  Captain of the 5th Division
__Zanpakutou:__ Kyouka Suigetsu  

Aizen is a polite, soft-spoken intellectual, often addressing his subordinates by their given names. He rarely shows any sign of alarm or distress and often has entire situations planned out well in advance. Whenever confronted, Aizen is casual and uncaring, attempting to draw out a conversation and make small talk, which often infuriates the one he is talking to. Aizen initially appeared to be a very kind, well-respected captain and was looked up to by many, especially his lieutenant, [Momo Hinamori](https://anilist.co/character/1092). characters.name: 市丸银
characters.description: 市丸银是《死神》中的角色，曾任护廷十三队三番队队长，常眯起眼睛微笑，持有斩魄刀神枪，长期跟随蓝染行动，与松本乱菊自幼相识，说话带有玩笑与试探，真实意图长期难以判断，战斗时刀刃可迅速伸长，曾背离尸魂界，对乱菊怀有深厚感情。他看似忠于蓝染，行动却一直隐藏着自己的目的。与乱菊的旧日关系贯穿他的选择，也让其他人很难从表情和言语看透他的想法。

characters.name: 京乐春水

source.description:
__Height:__ 192cm (6'3")
__Rank:__ Captain of the 8th Division ~!Later, Captain-Commander, Captain of the 1st Division!~  

Kyoraku is a laid back and flamboyant man, evident in his style of dress and general attitude. He wears a straw hat and a pink flowered haori over his captain's uniform. Although his haori and obi sash are cheap, his pinwheel hairpin is very expensive. In his off time, he can be seen drinking sake and napping. Other times, he likes to chase after women, which is noted by Yasochika Iemura of the 4th Squad when commenting in his diary. In particular, he often flirts with his lieutenant, Nanao Ise, whom he calls 'my Nanao-chan' (little Nanao).

He is close friends with 13th Division Captain Jushiro Ukitake, with whom he graduated from the shinigami academy and works with often.  Kyoraku tends to use a more familiar speech style than most other characters in Bleach. He generally refers to his fellow captains and shinigami by their first name followed by an honorific, and is the only character who dispenses with honorifics when addressing General Yamamoto, calling him old Yama (Yama-jī). Even Ukitake, who was also taught by Yamamoto, does not do this.

Kyoraku is a peace-loving man who will always try to talk his way out of a fight. However, he does not wish to insult his opponents by not fighting, either, as he explains to Chad. Since he has achieved the rank of captain, it is implied that he must be a powerful fighter, but the true extent of his abilities has not been seen in the anime. General Yamamoto states that Kyoraku and Jushiro Ukitake, both of whom he trained himself, possess "greater powers on the battlefield than any younger generation, or old," suggesting that the two are more powerful than any other captains, with the possible exception of Yamamoto himself.  The slightly eccentric Kyoraku also seems to like making an impression on opponents.

 ~!After Shigekuni Yamamoto-Genryuusai died, Jirou Sakuranosuke Shunsui became the captain of the 1st division.!~

characters.name: 浮竹十四郎
characters.description: 浮竹十四郎是《死神》中的角色，护廷十三队十三番队队长，有白色长发，身体长期受病痛困扰，持有双刀斩魄刀双鱼理，与京乐春水是好友，曾师从山本元柳斋，重视队员与人命，曾指导朽木露琪亚，性格温和，在尸魂界重大事件中坚持原则。他虽然身体虚弱，仍长期承担队长工作，以宽厚态度对待部下。面对露琪亚处刑等事件时，他愿意质疑不合理的命令。

Ukitake is the captain of the 13 Division in the Gotei 13. Ukitake Juushirou is respected by many, especially by his subordinates, for his honesty, loyalty, and personal sense of justice. He is afflicted with an unknown illness.

source.description:
__Height:__ 173 cm (5'8")
__Rank:__ Lieutenant of the 3rd Division

Izuru Kira was born to a family of lesser nobility, his parents having been dead since he was young. While in the Shinigami Academy, Kira befriended Momo Hinamori, Renji Abarai, and Shūhei Hisagi, and they were often seen spending time together. After graduation, Kira, along with Renji and Momo, was sent to the 5th Division, where he stayed until Gin Ichimaru became Captain of the 3rd Division. Kira is loyal to both his friends and his duties, perhaps to a fault. Despite the close friendship he shares with Momo Hinamori, Kira shows that his loyalty knows no boundaries when he defends his captain while she is in a grief-induced rage from her own Captain's apparent death. Despite this, he calls himself a "monster" afterwards for raising his sword against her.  Kira's Zanpakutō is Wabisuke. Its Shikai command is "Raise your head." When activated, Wabisuke's Shikai bends the blade into a square hook. In this form, Wabisuke doubles the weight of whatever it strikes. The ability affects both inanimate objects and living beings. Though a seemingly pointless ability in sword combat, the effect is cumulative. With a second hit from Wabisuke, the weight will double again and so on, exponentially. Thus, after seven or eight blocked attacks, his opponents are unable to lift their own swords. Once Wabisuke's effect becomes noticeable, Kira's opponents often fall to their knees with their heads bent down, as if in apology, thus the name of Kira's Zanpakutō.

characters.description: 桧佐木修兵是《死神》中的角色，护廷十三队九番队副队长，脸上有数字69纹身，持有斩魄刀风死，曾受东仙要指导，与松本乱菊等人共事，性格认真负责，对自己的斩魄刀怀有敬畏，在东仙叛变后面对复杂情感，擅长近身战斗，承担九番队日常工作。他重视队伍纪律，也相信战斗者应该敬畏死亡。曾经敬重的队长东仙走向敌对，让他不得不重新思考自己坚持的正义。

Tier Harribel, or Tier Hallibel in the English dub, is a fictional character from Kubo Tite's Bleach manga and the third Espada of Aizen Sousuke's army, the Espada. Harribel has dark skin, green eyes, blonde eyelashes, and messy short blonde hair which has three braided locks. She wears an oddly-cut variation of the Arrancar jacket that covers the lower part of her face down while baring a good portion of the lower half of her breasts; this jacket, unlike that of other Arrancar, is provided with a zipper running along its entire length that is opened from the bottom upwards. Harribel rarely speaks, and when she does, she's fairly serious. Compared to her fellow Espada, who are usually arrogant, boastful, impulsive, battle-hungry, bloodthirsty, and egotistical, Harribel is composed, receptive, analytical, and prefers not to engage in combat; she is content on silently observing both parties until the fighting reaches its conclusion, and actually fights only when she is challenged and attacked by an opponent or commanded to fight by her superiors.   

~!After Aizen's defeat and the deaths of Baraggan and Starrk, Harribel became the de facto ruler of Hueco Mundo. When an empire called the Wandenreich appeared, she was personally defeated by Yhwach and captured. The empire claimed Hueco Mundo as their dominion and another foundation stone to invade Soul Society.!~

source.description:
__Dragonball:__ Yamcha, the notorious desert bandit, started out as an antagonist of [Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu) but quickly became his friend thanks to [Bulma](https://anilist.co/character/678/Bulma). He lived in the desert, which resulted in him never having much female contact. Whenever he encountered Bulma, he would blush immensely and become petrified right on the spot.  Yamcha's trade mark move was known as the Fist of the Wolf Fang. With this move, he would strike the opponent with his hands in a claw like pose with his middle finger, ring finger and thumb curled.  His best friend is a floating shift-shaping cat named [Pu'ar](https://anilist.co/character/677/Puar).

__Dragonball Z:__ Yamcha's cleaned up his act as a desert bandit and become a member of the Z-fighters as well as a student of [Master Roshi](https://anilist.co/character/6167/Muten-Roushi).  Yamcha gained incredible ki control as displayed in his new signature move the Spirit Ball.  With this move, he can guide a ki ball in any direction using his middle and index fingers. 

~!When the Saiyans, [Vegeta](https://anilist.co/character/913/Vegeta) and his henchman [Nappa](https://anilist.co/character/5224/Nappa), first came to earth. Yamcha was the first to die after Nappa planted the Saibaman.  In the Android Saga, Yamcha was the first to discover [Androids 19](https://anilist.co/character/6115/Jinzouningen-19gou) and [20](https://anilist.co/character/2146/Dr-Gero) and was the second to be harmed by them (after [Yajirobe](https://anilist.co/character/2097/Yajirobe)).!~

source.description:
The "Turtle Immortal" is an ancient and wise martial arts master and the first Earthling to wield the Kamehameha. Though he seems frail, he is a mighty warrior. Muten-Rôshi trained [Grandpa Son Gohan](https://anilist.co/character/2104/Son-Gohan), [Ox King](https://anilist.co/character/2094/Gyuumaou), [Son Goku](https://anilist.co/character/246/Son-Gokuu), [Kuririn](https://anilist.co/character/2159/Kuririn), and [Yamcha](https://anilist.co/character/4014/Yamcha). His home, Kame House, a shack on a small isolated island, serves as a gathering place for the Z Fighters and friends.

He is a stock character, as he is both the archetypal wise old man and dirty old man, the latter being typical of shōnen anime. Sometimes he gets cranky, which further provides comic relief. He is bald, with a thick goatee and a thick mustache. Muten-Rôshi wears beach clothes or a martial arts suit and a turtle shell on his back. He usually wields a walking stick.

His companions are usually [Oolong](https://anilist.co/character/2108/Oolong), [Umigame](https://anilist.co/character/2112/Umigame) and [Lunch](https://anilist.co/character/2105/Lunch).

source.description: Tenshinhan is a fictional character from the Dragon Ball metaseries and the franchise equivalent created by Akira Toriyama. Trained by Muten-Rôshi's rival, the Crane hermit he starts out as an enemy of Son Goku, but soon makes peace and becomes an ally. He is usually accompanied by Chaozu, his training partner and best friend, whom he can communicate with telepathically.  At the time of his introduction, Tenshinhan is among the most powerful warriors in the series, matched only by Goku himself. Like most other characters, his relative strength quickly diminishes as the story progresses.  As is the case with a handful of other characters from the early chapters of Dragon Ball, Tenshinhan was inspired by a character from Journey to the West; his unique feature of having a third eye was derived from the Chinese god Erlang Shen.  According to the Daizenshuu book 7 and the PlayStation 2 game Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi, Tenshinhan belongs to the alien race of the "three-eyed".  (Source: Wikipedia)

source.description: Kanne is a third-class mage who graduated from the Academy of Magic. She is childhood friends and classmates with [Lawine](https://anilist.co/character/293727), and the two entered the first-class mage exam together. In the first stage of the exam, she was paired with Lawine and [Frieren](https://anilist.co/character/176754).

characters.name: 维亚贝尔
characters.description: 维亚贝尔是《葬送的芙莉莲》中的角色，二级魔法使，参加一级魔法使考试，担任第八队队长，来自北方地区，擅长拘束魔法，有丰富实战经验，与艾蕾和夏尔夫组队，性格务实，重视保护故乡，曾与尤贝尔等考生交手。他来自长期受到魔族威胁的北方，因此更看重实战能力而非漂亮的理论。考试中他带领队友冷静行动，必要时也会使用强硬手段。
traits: 曾与尤贝尔等考生交手

source.description: Second-class mage and the leader of the eighth party during the first stage of the First Class Mage Exam. He is the captain of the Northern Magic Corps and is thus a very experienced mage. Specializes in magic that restrains the opponent when their body is in full-view.

titles: มหาเวทย์ผนึกมาร

characters.name: 禅院真依
characters.description: 禅院真依是《咒术回战》中的角色，京都咒术高专学生，禅院真希的双胞胎妹妹，使用手枪作战，具有构筑术式，能够制造少量物质，与姐姐关系紧张，成长于禅院家，受到家族环境影响，与京都校同学共同参加交流会，内心在意真希的选择。她表面上常用刻薄的话语对待真希，实际两人的矛盾与家族压迫密切相关。她不愿被留下独自面对禅院家的规矩，因此对姐姐离开感到受伤。
traits: 禅院真希的双胞胎妹妹
与京都校同学共同参加交流会

source.description:
__Height:__ 170 cm (5'7")

Mai Zenin is the younger twin sister of [Maki Zenin](https://anilist.co/character/134167/Maki-Zenin). Mai is a grade 3 sorcerer and a second-year at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School. As a child, Mai always relied on Maki since she was afraid of Cursed Spirits. 

~!Because Mai and Maki are monozygotic twins, their strength is considerably limited to one another. Monozygotic twins are considered as a single individual in the Jujutsu world and are a sign of bad omen.!~

~!In chapter 149, Mai decides to sacrifice herself in order to make Maki stronger.!~

characters.name: 三轮霞
characters.description: 三轮霞是《咒术回战》中的角色，京都咒术高专学生，使用日本刀作战，擅长新阴流简易领域，留着浅蓝色头发，性格温和，崇拜五条悟，与机械丸是同学，希望通过咒术师工作帮助家人，参加京都姊妹校交流会，在战斗中认真努力。她出身普通家庭，对京都校一些同学的强硬态度并不总认同。成为咒术师的重要原因是支持家人，即使面对强敌也努力完成自己的职责。
traits: 希望通过咒术师工作帮助家人
参加京都姊妹校交流会

source.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer, Student
__Affiliation:__ Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College
__Grade:__ Grade 3 Sorcerer

A second-year at Kyoto Metropolitan Curse Technical College. Kasumi is a hard-working, restrained, and considerate pacifist. She is also a big fan of [Satoru Gojo](https://anilist.co/character/127691).

~!She has a very close bond with [Mechamaru](https://anilist.co/character/210154), their friendship is first seen in the Tournament Arc when Miwa offers him a battery telling him not to eat it as [Mai](https://anilist.co/character/134168) and [Momo](https://anilist.co/character/157868) laugh in the background. In the Shibuya Arc, she is seen mourning his death on the train. Over the course of the Tournament Arc and Shibuya Arc it is very apparent their friendship grows as they both strived towards becoming closer to one another. As she mourns his death on the train she holds a mini Mechamaru speaker which tells her to find her happiness. After the recording finishes, she holds the speaker to her heart and cries. The entire Kyoto program seems very distressed by his death on the train. When later entering the battle Miwa is quick to activate her technique out of rage and sadness towards [Mahito](https://anilist.co/character/133702).!~

characters.name: 庵歌姬
characters.description: 庵歌姬是《咒术回战》中的角色，京都咒术高专教师，一级咒术师，负责指导京都校学生，脸上有明显伤痕，常穿巫女风格服装，与五条悟相识多年，常被五条的玩笑惹恼，关心学生安全，参与学校交流会，具备辅助同伴的术式。她担任京都校老师，遇到学生面临危险时会积极采取行动。虽然与五条悟经常拌嘴，她在咒术界事件中仍与其他术师合作。

source.description: A first grade sorcerer and a teacher at Kyoto Jujutsu Technical High School.

characters.name: 加茂宪纪
characters.description: 加茂宪纪是《咒术回战》中的角色，京都咒术高专学生，加茂家族成员，使用赤血操术，能操控自身血液战斗，擅长弓箭，发型规整，肩负家族继承期待，与东京校伏黑惠交手，参加姊妹校交流会，性格严肃重视家族责任。他被家族安排承担继承人的角色，因此对自己的举止与成绩要求很高。交流会中的战斗展现了赤血操术的多种用法，也让他与其他学生产生联系。
traits: 性格严肃重视家族责任

source.description:
__Cursed Technique:__ Blood Manipulation
__Grade:__ Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer

He is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

characters.name: 花御
characters.description: 花御是《咒术回战》中的角色，特级咒灵，与真人等咒灵合作，能够操纵植物，重视自然环境，认为人类破坏森林，外形具备树木般特征，袭击京都姊妹校交流会，拥有强韧的身体，与东堂葵和虎杖悠仁交战，在咒灵阵营中担任战斗力量。它把保护自然视为行动理由，因此站到与人类术师对立的一方。交流会遭袭时，花御凭借植物术式与强大防御让多名学生陷入苦战。
traits: 袭击京都姊妹校交流会
与东堂葵和虎杖悠仁交战
在咒灵阵营中担任战斗力量

source.description:
__Species:__ Cursed Spirit

Hanami is an antagonist intent on ridding the Earth of Humans and reviving [Sukuna](https://anilist.co/character/133701/Sukuna).

characters.name: 九十九由基
characters.description: 九十九由基是《咒术回战》中的角色，特级咒术师，长期在海外活动，关注咒灵产生的根本原因，主张研究让人类摆脱咒力的方法，曾与夏油杰交谈，是东堂葵的师父，战斗实力很强，性格洒脱直接，喜欢问人喜欢怎样的女性，与咒术高层理念不同。她不满足于只靠消灭咒灵处理问题，而是试图从人类咒力本身寻找解决办法。与夏油、东堂等人的相遇，也对他们的思考和成长产生影响。
traits: 关注咒灵产生的根本原因
主张研究让人类摆脱咒力的方法
喜欢问人喜欢怎样的女性

source.description: One of the four Special Grade Sorcerers.

characters.name: 吉野顺平
characters.description: 吉野顺平是《咒术回战》中的角色，里樱高中学生，长期遭受同学霸凌，喜欢电影，与真人相识，拥有水母式神淀月，对咒术界最初了解有限，与虎杖悠仁成为朋友，母亲吉野凪关心他，性格内向，被真人的言语操纵。他希望找到理解自己的人，因此容易受到真人的利用。与虎杖的短暂友谊让他看到另一种可能，但悲剧仍成为虎杖成长中难忘的经历。
traits: 对咒术界最初了解有限

source.description: A student at Satozakura High School.

characters.name: 猪野琢真
characters.description: 猪野琢真是《咒术回战》中的角色，东京咒术高专相关术师，二级咒术师，常戴针织帽，十分敬重七海建人，使用来访瑞兽术式，战斗时会遮住脸部，与虎杖等后辈合作，性格热情，希望获得七海认可，参与涩谷事件中的任务。他把七海视为值得学习的前辈，努力以自己的术式和行动证明实力。虽然有时显得冲动，他在危险任务中始终认真保护同伴。
traits: 东京咒术高专相关术师
参与涩谷事件中的任务

source.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__ Jujutsu High
__Grade:__ Grade 2 Sorcerer

Takuma Ino is a grade 2 jujutsu sorcerer and a close associate of Kento Nanami who operates out of Tokyo Jujutsu High.

Takuma Ino is a genuine and cheerful person with a more positive outlook on things than most jujutsu sorcerers. He doesn't believe he's the smartest person around and has a lot of respect for Nanami. Whenever Ino finds himself in a tough situation, he asks himself what would Nanami do.

characters.name: 西宫桃
characters.description: 西宫桃是《咒术回战》中的角色，京都咒术高专学生，能够骑扫帚飞行，使用付丧操术，擅长空中侦查，与三轮霞和禅院真依同校，参加姊妹校交流会，关注真依受到的待遇，对女性咒术师处境有看法，身材娇小，性格直率。她能借助扫帚保持空中优势，为队伍提供侦查与支援。她非常在意真依，对咒术界评价女性术师的方式也常表达不满。
traits: 与三轮霞和禅院真依同校
对女性咒术师处境有看法

source.description:
__Species:__ Human
__Occupation:__ Jujutsu Sorcerer
__Affiliation:__  Kyoto Magic Technical College
__Grade:__ Semi-Grade 2 Sorcerer
__Cursed Technique:__ Tool Manipulation

She is a third-year at Kyoto Magic Technical College.

titles: ฮันเตอร์ x ฮันเตอร์

characters.name: 西索·莫罗
characters.description: 西索·莫罗是《全职猎人》中的角色，职业猎人考试的考生，擅长伸缩自在的爱念能力，外表常带小丑装扮，喜欢与强者交手，战斗中善用扑克牌，曾加入幻影旅团，对小杰与奇犽的成长感兴趣，性格危险且难以预测，拥有高超格斗能力，多次与主角团相遇。他把战斗视为最大的乐趣，常故意留给有潜力的对手成长时间。对小杰等人时而帮助、时而构成威胁，是立场多变的重要人物。
traits: 擅长伸缩自在的爱念能力
对小杰与奇犽的成长感兴趣

source.description:
__Height: __187 cm

Notorious for his cruel and deceitful fighting ability, Hisoka has proven to be deadly. His deviousness and volatility have caused many opponents to have difficulty anticipating his next move, and this has led to him winning many battles. Using Shu powered poker cards as his primary weapon, he throws them with ease and deadly accuracy.  

He is very intrigued by [Gon](https://anilist.co/character/30/Gon-Freecss) and the potential this young boy has to become an adept and powerful adversary. Hisoka, ever looking for a strong opponent, is willing to aid, or at least not defeat prematurely, someone that could develop into a future opponent.

characters.name: 伊路米·揍敌客
characters.description: 伊路米·揍敌客是《全职猎人》中的角色，揍敌客家长子，奇犽的兄长，职业杀手，擅长使用针操控人，念能力属于操作系，有黑色长发，在猎人考试中伪装身份，对奇犽施加心理控制，与西索有合作关系，行事冷静而令人不安。他从小接受揍敌客家的杀手训练，对奇犽的未来有强烈控制欲。虽然常声称关心弟弟，其做法却使奇犽难以自由选择自己的道路。
traits: 在猎人考试中伪装身份

source.description:
__Height:__ 185 cm 
__Nen Type:__ Manipulation   

Illumi is [Killua's](https://anilist.co/character/27/Killua-Zoldyck) eldest brother. He is an experienced assassin, whom along with his father was responsible for Killua's training and upbringing.

characters.name: 库洛洛·鲁西鲁
characters.description: 库洛洛·鲁西鲁是《全职猎人》中的角色，幻影旅团团长，出身流星街，额头有十字形纹身，擅长盗取他人念能力，使用盗贼的极意，冷静而富有领导力，率领旅团在友克鑫活动，与酷拉皮卡对立，重视旅团成员，拥有出色的战术头脑。他在旅团中拥有很高威望，既能策划大型行动，也能亲自与强敌交手。友克鑫事件使他与酷拉皮卡及其他猎人产生严重冲突。
traits: 率领旅团在友克鑫活动

source.description:
__Height:__ 177 cm 
__Occupation:__ Leader of the Phantom Troupe 
__Nen Type:__ Specialization  
 
Chrollo Lucilfer is a calm, young man, coming across as intelligent and charismatic. He seems to be a born leader, able to hold the Genei Ryodan (Phantom Troupe) together despite the volatile personalities that make up the group. He is also an incredibly skilled fighter.

characters.name: 桀诺·揍敌客
characters.description: 桀诺·揍敌客是《全职猎人》中的角色，揍敌客家族长辈，奇犽的祖父，席巴的父亲，经验丰富的职业杀手，能以龙形念能力攻击，性格老练，曾与库洛洛交手，重视委托中的职业判断，对家族后辈有影响，拥有高超战斗技巧。他在揍敌客家族中经验丰富，行动时会冷静评估任务与对手。友克鑫事件中与席巴一同对抗库洛洛，展现了老练的战斗能力。
traits: 重视委托中的职业判断

source.description:
Zeno Zoldyck is Killua's grandfather and Silva's father. 

A witty old man, his advancing age has not dampened his quick thinking and speed in battle. Zeno wears alternating signs on his garb that say either "A Kill A Day" or "Never Retire." He appears to be on good terms with the Hunter Committee's Chairman, Netero, who hired Zeno to assault Ming Jol-ik's palace in East Gorteau in order to catch the chimera ant King off guard. 

Zeno favors Killua more than his other grandchildren, most likely because Killua is the heir of the family.

characters.name: 尼飞彼多
characters.description: 尼飞彼多是《全职猎人》中的角色，嵌合蚁王直属护卫队成员，有猫科动物般的外形，拥有极强的念能力，负责保护蚁王，擅长操纵和治疗类能力，曾与凯特交战，使小杰承受巨大打击，对蚁王非常忠诚，性格兼具好奇与残酷，在嵌合蚁篇担任关键对手。彼多初次出现就展现压倒性实力，凯特的遭遇也使小杰陷入痛苦。随着蚁王对小麦的态度变化，彼多不得不在命令与战斗间作出选择。
traits: 嵌合蚁王直属护卫队成员
擅长操纵和治疗类能力
在嵌合蚁篇担任关键对手

source.description:
__Nen Type:__ Specialization

A cat-humanoid Chimera Ant and the firstborn of the Chimera Ant King's three Royal Guards.

Neferpitou is very loyal to the King, just like the rest of the Royal Guards that would sacrifice themselves for him. Neferpitou gets distracted easily, loves to play a lot and that makes them the most curious of the three Royal Guards. Hence their cat-like appearance, Pitou is a cat Chimera Ant who loves to play with their opponents like a cat would with their prey. Despite their cheerful and playful manner, Pitou has a sadistic and terrifying personality as well. 

Unlike [Menthuthuyoupi](https://anilist.co/character/43953/Menthuthuyoupi) and [Shaiapouf](https://anilist.co/character/41135/Shaiapouf), Neferpitou does not seem to mind much in regards to [Meruem's](https://anilist.co/character/23277/Meruem) later newfound interests with [Komugi](https://anilist.co/character/14313/Komugi). Thus, among the three Royal Guards, Neferpitou is the only one that greatly prioritizes Komugi's safety as opposed to how Menthuthuyoupi and Shaiapouf hate Komugi, which causes tension among the guards.

characters.name: 比司吉·酷露佳
characters.description: 比司吉·酷露佳是《全职猎人》中的角色，资深职业猎人，擅长训练念能力，常以少女外表行动，真实体格十分强壮，曾指导小杰与奇犽，参与贪婪之岛游戏，重视修行基础，喜欢收集宝石，念能力可协助恢复体力，战斗经验丰富。她在贪婪之岛与小杰、奇犽相遇，发现两人的潜力后展开严格训练。可爱外表容易让人低估她，真正战斗时却展现出老练实力。
nicknames: ビスケット＝クルーガー
traits: 念能力可协助恢复体力

source.name_native: ビスケット＝クルーガー
source.description:
Biscuit is a master and experienced teacher of Nen. She continues the Nen training Wing gave to Gon and Killua during the Greed Island arc. As a Treasure Hunter, Biscuit loves collecting rare jewels (and gets very excited about them; she has a habit of naming them) and getting money. Biscuit has a devious personality. She initially uses her cutesy appearance and demeanor to her advantage whether it's for information gathering, getting what she wants, or even in combat by acting innocent and helpless so most people will usually put their guards down around her. However, as a teacher of Nen, she has a stern and serious attitude towards her students.   

~!Though in the beginning she was out to trouble Gon and Killua, at the end of the Greed Island arc she acknowledges (albeit, in her head) that she's close to developing parental feelings toward the two of them.!~

characters.name: 尼特罗
characters.description: 尼特罗是《全职猎人》中的角色，猎人协会会长，武术修行者，拥有极高战斗能力，喜欢考验年轻猎人，使用百式观音战斗，负责应对嵌合蚁危机，外表是年迈老人，性格顽皮又有威严，重视人类的潜力，与蚁王展开决战。他在猎人协会中地位极高，却一直保持对挑战的兴趣。嵌合蚁威胁扩大后，他亲自走上战场，与蚁王一战成为故事重要转折。

source.description:
__Nen type:__ Enhancement

None other than the Chairman of the Hunter Committee, and the final authority over the entirety of the Hunter Exam. He has enough administrative power to grant anyone the Hunter's license if he decides to do so, and enough combat power to playfully avoid attacks of the main heroes single-handedly when they challenge him. All examiners, even the most despotic ones, obey his orders without talking back.  He was said to be the strongest Nen user in the world 50 years ago, but he comments that he is already past his prime at his current age and that his subordinates might be stronger than him now (yet his direct subordinates disagree). Netero is also revealed to be older than Zeno Zoldyck (Killua's Grandfather), who is said to be 67 years of age. 

At one point, Zeno says that when he was still a young boy, Netero was not only already old, but he is the only person alive who has fought with Maha (Zeno's) grandfather. Various stated times would put Netero over the three digit mark. He is able to use attacks faster than the speed of sound. He also uses the hyakushiki kannon which is also known as the 'Hundred Style of Buddha'. This utilizes nen to make the attacks seem as if they had come from another side and or dimension, simply because they move so fast.  In the manga he is also shown fighting chimera ants and is heading towards the destined fight with the King. His assistants Morau and Novu note that he was the strongest Nen user 50 years ago, and show great respect for his abilities.

characters.name: 梅路艾姆
characters.description: 梅路艾姆是《全职猎人》中的角色，嵌合蚁之王，出生时拥有惊人力量，受到直属护卫队保护，起初蔑视人类，擅长学习与分析，与小麦反复对弈军仪，逐渐理解情感与尊重，与尼特罗展开决战，对自身存在意义产生思考，是嵌合蚁篇核心人物。他最初只按强弱衡量生命，与盲眼棋手小麦相处后却慢慢改变。军仪对局让他认识到力量之外的价值，也影响他面对人类的选择。
traits: 对自身存在意义产生思考

source.description:
He was the most powerful offspring of the Chimera Ant Queen. He was known as the King of the Chimera Ants, and served as the main antagonist of the Chimera Ant arc.

~!Meruem is first seen when he violently rips through the womb of the [Chimera Ant Queen](https://anilist.co/character/83183/Chimera-Ant-Queen) from the inside, ready to emerge into the world and unwilling to wait for a natural birth. Shortly after his birth, Meruem leaves the hive and NGL with the Royal Guards, in search of a place to start his kingdom. He descends on the Republic of East Gorteau and takes over over the country by killing its dictator, Ming Jol-ik. Meruem then uses Jol-ik's corpse as a puppet to order East Gorteau's population of approximately five million to gather simultaneously in the capital city for a national rally. This however, is a ruse, designed to create a situation where entire towns and villages could be secretly abducted for a "selection", the forcible awakening of nen, without their disappearance being noticed.

Meruem's eventual plan was to take the one percent of the population that would survive such an awakening and turn them into soldiers for an army he will use to conquer the world. This plan is temporarily disrupted by [Killua](https://anilist.co/character/27/Killua-Zoldyck), who assassinates a number of "selectors", but a backup plan is soon implemented; East Gorteau is put under martial law, and the population undergo selection in their own homes, though this slows down the process considerably, and only 500,000 people are processed, with 5,000 predicted survivors. Soon after this occurs, the Hunters [Netero](https://anilist.co/character/14489/Isaac-Netero), [Morel](https://anilist.co/character/29806/Morel-Mackernasey), [Knuckle](https://anilist.co/character/29809/Knuckle-Bine), [Shoot](https://anilist.co/character/29807/Shoot-McMahon), Killua, and [Gon](https://anilist.co/character/30/Gon-Freecss) attack the palace, with the intention of separating the Royal Guards from Meruem and assassinating him.

Meruem's initial personality, when he his first shown in the story, is that of arrogance. The Queen's intention to give birth to a perfect offspring is reflected in Meruem's mentality. He considered himself superior to all other forms of life and felt no concern for his dying mother after his "birth." Meruem was also merciless, instantly killing any chimera ant he considered disrespectful. Meruem was seen killing and eating other chimera ants, something no other chimera ant had ever done.

After reaching East Gorteau and putting his plans into motion, Meruem took an interest in various board games, and gathered various champion-level players to his palace. Simply by reading the rule books, Meruem was able to master any game in under ten matches, simultaneously learning from his opponents while disrupting the "flow" of their play style. After defeating the best player for each game, Meruem proceeded to kill them, as they were of no further use to him.

The final game Meruem learns is Gungi, a fictional shogi-like board game invented by East Gorteau. The world champion for the game is Komugi, a seemingly dimwitted blind girl; However, as Meruem played against her, he found himself unable to disrupt her flow, while at the same time, the challenge of playing against Meruem caused [Komugi](https://anilist.co/character/14313/Komugi)'s skills to increase. Much to the shock of the Royal Guards, Meruem even starts show respect for Komugi and concern for Komugi's well being. In one instance Meruem rips his left arm off, as an apology to Komugi for asking her to bet her left arm on a game, to which she replied that she always bet her life. In another instance, after watching Komugi's nen suddenly awaken, and realizing she would grow exponentially stronger, but only in terms of Gungi, Meruem momentarily decides that his power of "violence" was the strongest type of strength, and ultimately Komugi's abilities are meaningless; Yet, moments after this decision, Meruem finds Komugi under attack by a large bird of prey, and is unable to bring himself to do anything except protect her, ultimately unable to understand his own emotions toward Komugi. This leaves Meruem in a contemplative state, wondering about the purpose for his existence in the world.

As of chapter 290 of the manga, Meruem is preparing to battle Netero, who attacked his castle in order to assassinate him. Before the battle, Komugi is gravely injured by a nen ability meant to cause confusion within the palace, and Meruem orders [Neferpitou](https://anilist.co/character/12300/Neferpitou) to save her life. The way Meruem is drawn in this scene suggests he has learned what it means to have concern for someone else's well being.

He and Netero then travel to a remote location that was once used for military weapons testing, so that they may both go all out in their fight. However, in a surprising twist, Meruem refuses to fight the Hunter. Through a short conversation between the two, the King reveals that he finally realizes that he should use his power to protect the weak, seeing from Komugi that there are humans who deserve to live; Netero counted among them. He also expresses a desire to remake the world so that everyone is so equal, the term "equality" would become obsolete. Netero realizes that Meruem is dangerously caught between his Ant instincts and his humanity, and at this point, either facet of his psyche could win out. Knowing that he has a mission to carry out regardless, and not wanting his heart to waver, Netero suddenly assaults Meruem first with a devastating attack.

Meruem possesses a nen ability that allows him to absorb the raw aura of nen-users he has killed. By devouring their brain, he adds their aura to his own--further increasing his power. His fighting ability is such that even Netero, chairman of the Hunter committee, expresses doubt that he could defeat him.!~

characters.name: 斯卡
characters.description: 斯卡是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，伊修瓦尔幸存者，额头有十字伤疤，右臂刻有炼金术阵，能够分解接触到的物质，早期追杀国家炼金术师，家人在伊修瓦尔战争中遇害，对军部怀有仇恨，与爱德华兄弟多次交手，后来反思复仇的意义，在国家危机中与他人合作。他带着战争造成的创伤行动，起初把所有国家炼金术师都视为敌人。随着真相逐渐显现，他开始在复仇与保护幸存者之间寻找新的道路。

source.description: Scar is a disturbed loner. His right arm does not belong to him, but his brother. His brother was obsessed with finding the Philosopher's Stone and tattooed his whole body.   During the Ishval civil war...  ~!an alchemist, Solf J. Kimblee, killed his brother, blew off Scar's arm, and gave him the "X" scar on his forehead. Scar's brother then transmuted his own arm onto Scar's shoulder, giving the maimed warrior priest the powers of alchemic deconstruction that he then uses in his quest for vengeance.!~ Scar seeks his revenge against the state alchemists, all of whom he blames for the destruction of Ishval. His wrath does not extend, however, to non-state alchemists, which is why he does not seek to kill [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Elric-Alphonse) during their frequent confrontations.

characters.name: 伊兹米·卡迪斯
characters.description: 伊兹米·卡迪斯是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，爱德华与阿尔冯斯的老师，擅长炼金术与体术，经营肉店，与丈夫西格关系亲密，曾进行人体炼成，因此失去部分内脏，能不用炼成阵发动炼金术，对弟子要求严格，实际非常关心弟子，参与对抗人造人的行动。她教会爱德华兄弟炼金术与生存原则，也因两人触犯禁忌而愤怒。共同经历人体炼成的痛苦，使师徒之间建立更深的理解。
traits: 爱德华与阿尔冯斯的老师
能不用炼成阵发动炼金术
参与对抗人造人的行动

source.description:
__Nationality:__ Amestrian

Izumi Curtis, born Izumi Harnet, the teacher of [Ed](https://anilist.co/character/11/Elric-Edward) and [Alphonse Elric](https://anilist.co/character/12/Elric-Alphonse), agreed to train the brothers to hone their alchemical abilities after their mother died. She expands their training with a regimen of philosophy, martial arts, and living off the land. Her methods are derived from her own alchemy training: in the manga and second anime, she was forced to survive in the northern region surrounding Briggs Fortress for a month (although it turns out she succeeded by stealing supplies from the northern fortress), whereas in the first anime she was taught by [Dante](https://anilist.co/character/18880/Dante).

She thinks of the Elrics as her own sons, and although she severs her student-teacher ties with them after learning of their attempts with human transmutation (and similarly Ed's joining the State Military), she continues to do all she can to help them. She can be quite violent when punishing or sparring with the Elric brothers, so they tend to be deathly afraid of her.

Her claim of "I'm a housewife!" while confronting [Greed](https://anilist.co/character/351/Greed) was a favorite scene of Arakawa's to draw.

Izumi and her husband [Sig Curtis](https://anilist.co/character/10972/Curtis-Sig) were expecting a child years before the start of the series; however, their son was stillborn. Izumi tried and failed to revive the child through human transmutation (an act that created [Wrath](https://anilist.co/character/6917/Wrath) in the first anime). The failed attempt took some of her internal organs, resulting in infertility, and causing her to periodically cough up blood. Izumi gained the ability to use alchemy without a transmutation circle after seeing the "truth."  In the manga, Izumi attracts the attention of the State Military for surviving the failed human transmutation. As she and her husband travel around Amestris in order to avoid the military, they eventually meet Ed and Al's father Hohenheim. He rearranges her insides to ease the blood flow, and persuades her to help collaborate in bringing down the State Military.

characters.name: 马斯·休斯
characters.description: 马斯·休斯是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，军部情报人员，罗伊·马斯坦古的好友，妻子名格蕾西亚，十分疼爱女儿爱莉西亚，性格开朗健谈，擅长情报调查，常向同事展示女儿照片，发现军部阴谋的线索，与爱德华兄弟关系友好，其遭遇深刻影响罗伊。他总是以家庭话题活跃气氛，却也有敏锐的调查能力。接近国家核心秘密后，他卷入危险，留下的线索和遗憾推动罗伊继续追查。
traits: 十分疼爱女儿爱莉西亚
常向同事展示女儿照片
与爱德华兄弟关系友好

source.description:
__Nationality:__ Amestrian
__Occupation:__ Intelligence Agent

Maes Hughes is an Amestrian State Military officer stationed in the Investigations Office in Central City and Colonel Roy Mustang's best friend, as well as the closest supporter of Mustang's secret bid for the position of Führer. A devoted family man and exemplary soldier, Hughes is generally well-liked by the other characters.     ~!He is killed by Envy upon his discovery of Father's plans, and is posthumously promoted to Brigadier General!~

characters.name: 古利德
characters.description: 古利德是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，七宗罪人造人之一，代表贪婪，拥有最强之盾能力，能够硬化身体，曾率领合成兽同伴，反抗父亲的控制，渴望拥有属于自己的伙伴，后来与姚麟共用身体，性格狂放，在关键时刻帮助主角一方。他声称想得到世上的一切，却逐渐意识到自己真正重视的是伙伴。与姚麟共享身体的经历，让两人在利益和信念上不断磨合。
traits: 渴望拥有属于自己的伙伴
在关键时刻帮助主角一方

source.description:
Greed is a greedy Homunculus, nicknamed the "Ultimate Shield". He is able to rearrange the carbon in his body to make his skin as hard as diamond, thus making himself almost impossible to injure. As his name implies he is a very avaricious character, who likes living in luxury, surrounded by powerful minions and beautiful women. Despite his generally greedy nature, he’s shown to honestly care for his subordinates. He also has a habit of flipping people off in the manga.    

 __In the 2003 anime series:__  Greed is the second oldest of the Homunculi created by Dante. However, due to his avarice, Greed rebelled and was eventually captured and imprisoned in lab 5. He was imprisoned for 130 years until an explosion broke his seal. He then freed the caged chimera at Lab 5 in exchange for helping him get his revenge on the other homunculi and their master.    

 __In the manga and 2009 anime series:__  He is the third Homunculus created by Father. Greed apparently abandoned the other Homunculi over 100 years before the start of the series and claims to be around two centuries old. He first appears hiding in the Devil's Nest in Dublith, with his gang of chimeras all of whom he apparently rescued from military experimentation.      ~!After Greed is punished by Father, he later returns as Father removes his son's Philosopher's Stone core from his own body and inserts it directly into the body of Ling Yao to create a second Human-based Homunculus. This second Greed maintains all the same personality and powers as the first (his Ouroboros tattoo is even in the same spot), but appears to have none of his previous memories, not recognizing Envy, Gluttony, or the Elric Brothers. As such, he becomes a faithful servant of his Father, as the first Greed was presumed to have been initially, and refers to all actions prior to his rebirth as having been done by "the other Greed".    After killing a past comrade and follower of his, memories from Greed's previous life returned, including his time in the Devil's Nest and the feelings he had for his followers. Remembering this, along with how Bradley killed most of his followers, leads Greed to betray Father once again. He also stops referring to his "previous self" as "the other Greed" upon regaining his memories.  !~

characters.name: 拉斯特
characters.description: 拉斯特是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，七宗罪人造人之一，代表色欲，拥有最强之矛能力，能够伸长尖锐的手指，常以美丽女性形象行动，奉父亲命令执行任务，擅长引诱与欺骗，与格拉托尼经常同行，在暗中推动军部阴谋，与罗伊等人发生冲突。她外表优雅，行动却十分残酷，常在幕后清除妨碍计划的人。深入军方的阴谋使她与罗伊一方正面交锋，能力对战斗造成巨大威胁。
traits: 常以美丽女性形象行动

source.description:
Lust is a Homunculus, nicknamed the "Ultimate Spear", and one of the first antagonists in the Fullmetal Alchemist series. She is the first Homunculus to appear in the series and plays a significant role in the plot of both the manga and 2003 anime series. Lust is also usually partnered with Gluttony to whom she appears to have a particular almost motherly closeness. Her Ouroboros mark is located on her collarbone, just above her breasts.     

__In the 2003 anime series;__ She is largely the same as her manga counterpart, highly intelligent, manipulative, devoted to her own ideals, however she begins to crave becoming a human as the series progresses. Her main purpose amongst the Homunculi is gathering information and traveling abroad, manipulating alchemists into creating Philosopher's Stones. Gaining true humanity is the focal point of her ambition, arguably much more so than the rest of the Homunculi.     

~!Lust was created by Scar's brother, when he attempted to use alchemy to bring his lover back from the dead. After he was cast out from Ishbalan society as a heretic, [Envy](https://anilist.co/character/651/Envy) visited the wretched creature and fed it red stones, giving her human shape, and her new name. She was not the first Homunculus to bear the name of Lust, and is the third youngest Homunculus.!~

__In the manga and 2009 anime series;__ Lust is the only female Homunculus and the second to be created by [Father](https://anilist.co/character/15542/Flask-no-Homunculus). Due to her high intelligence and devotion to Father's plan, Lust appears to have a great deal of free reign and authority within the organization, seeming to have a position second only to Pride and on par with Wrath. Lust also has a great disdain for humans, thinking them frail, predictable and generally stupid. Moreover, she appears to take pleasure in using and throwing them away. Lust is the first to introduce the idea of Homunculi as superhuman, the next wave of evolution of humanity, and takes pride in her nature.

characters.name: 恩维
characters.description: 恩维是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，七宗罪人造人之一，代表嫉妒，拥有变换外形的能力，常以他人面貌制造混乱，参与伊修瓦尔战争的阴谋，性格残忍且爱嘲讽，与爱德华兄弟对立，奉父亲命令行动，真实形态与人形差异巨大，对人类抱有复杂情绪。他利用变身能力挑拨人与人之间的信任，是国家阴谋的重要执行者。面对人类之间的团结时，他的嫉妒与自尊逐渐暴露出来。
traits: 常以他人面貌制造混乱
参与伊修瓦尔战争的阴谋
真实形态与人形差异巨大

source.description:
__Occupation:__ Instigator for Father
__Ability:__ Shapeshifting
__Goal:__ Cause discord among humans

Envy is a homunculus who has the ability to shapeshift. They use this power to assume the form of any person and even copy their voice. They usually serve as a spy, but their abilities are also extremely useful for assassinations. Envy may not be as smart as some of the other homunculi, but they are by no means an idiot. In fact, they can be just as good a puppet master as Lust, but this is overshadowed by their cockiness and bad temper. This temper can easily be set off by insulting their large and delicate ego, causing them to make mistakes.  

__In the 2003 anime series:__ As the oldest Homunculus, Envy claimed that they had forgotten what they originally looked like. Envy also greatly hates all humans and followed Dante mostly for the opportunity of killing as many people as they could. This is what drove Envy in all that they did and unlike other Homunculi, Envy does not care about the Philosopher's Stone, nor about becoming human. ~!Towards the very end of the series it is revealed that Envy was created four hundred years ago by Hohenheim in an attempt to resurrect the son he and Dante had, who later died from mercury poisoning when he was eighteen years old. Envy held a great hatred toward Hohenheim for never being acknowledged as his son and for abandoning them and Dante.!~  

__In the manga and 2009 anime series:__ Envy was the fourth Homunculus created by Father. Though often referred to as a 'he' Envy is apparently genderless and can take almost any form it chooses. Referred to by Lust as the most cruel or sadistic of the Homunculi, Envy shows the most open disdain of humans and relishes in any opportunity to hurt, humiliate, or insult them. They are also quite vain and short tempered and dislikes anyone insulting their appearance. ~!Beneath this cruel exterior, however, Envy is secretly envious of humans' inner strength and the mutually beneficial friendships that they share, since most of the Homunculi show little real concern or emotional support for each other.!~  

(Source: Fullmetal Alchemist Wikia)

characters.name: 亚历克斯·路易·阿姆斯特朗
characters.description: 亚历克斯·路易·阿姆斯特朗是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，国家炼金术师，军衔为少校，外号豪腕炼金术师，拥有强壮体格，常展示家族传承的肌肉，使用拳套发动炼金术，性格热情且富有同情心，与姐姐奥莉薇相识，曾经历伊修瓦尔战争，积极保护爱德华兄弟。他虽然外表威猛，却经常为他人的苦难流泪。伊修瓦尔战争的经历让他反思军人的责任，此后愿意帮助爱德华兄弟阻止阴谋。
nicknames: 亚历克斯·路易·阿姆斯特朗

source.description:
__Birthplace:__ Amestris
__Occupation:__ State Alchemist

Major Alex Louis Armstrong, the Strong Arm Alchemist, was born into an elite family of alchemists and has mastered his family's techniques. Members of his family have, in the past, filled the highest military and political positions in the state. He acquired his alchemy titles for his skill of using arm strength in his alchemy. All though he may look intimidating, he is really friendly and (overly)affectionate, and often stays behind or risks his life for the safety of others. He also has a tendency to show off techniques passed down to him to his enemies, and make them feel somewhat awkward during a battle.

characters.name: 姚麟
characters.description: 姚麟是《钢之炼金术师》中的角色，新国皇子，来自东方的新国，带兰芳与福爷同行，寻找长生不老的方法，擅长武术与感知气息，性格开朗但有政治目标，与爱德华兄弟合作，后来与古利德共用身体，重视自己的部下，希望成为新国皇帝。他为了家族和人民远赴亚美斯多利斯，追寻能够改变继承竞争的力量。与古利德共存后，他仍坚持保护兰芳等伙伴。
traits: 性格开朗但有政治目标
后来与古利德共用身体

source.description:
__Occupation:__ Prince
__Goal:__ To find the secret of immortality and become Xingese Emperor

Ling Yao is a Xingese character exclusive to the manga and the 2009 anime series. Due to his father, the Emperor's, declining health, Ling left his country to find the Philosopher's Stone to stabilize Xing, as well as grant him the key to immortality. Although he is the 12th son of the Emperor, Ling hopes the Philosopher's Stone will help him rise in the order of succession and achieve the throne thereby securing his clan's welfare. Though he is often laid back and hungry, he's very noble and will do whatever it takes to help his clan. He is also a skilled fighter and has had many incidents involving assassination attempts at his life. He has formed a strong rivalry with [Ed](https://anilist.co/character/11/Elric-Edward), by doing things such as use Ed's money to annoy him.   ~!After the 1st Greed is punished by Father, he gives Ling the secret to immortality by transforming him into the succeeding Greed. Ed tries to help, but Ling denies his help as it is the only way to help his clan in the land of Xing. Even while his body is taken over by Greed his mind and soul are kept intact and can come to the surface. Since Greed understands his strong points their relationship is on some kind of symbiotic level.!~

(Source: Fullmetal Alchemist wiki)

characters.description: 相田剑介是《新世纪福音战士》中的角色，碇真嗣的同班同学，铃原东治的好友，热爱军事装备，喜欢摄影，对EVA很感兴趣，在第三新东京市生活，曾与真嗣一起目睹使徒战斗，性格外向，愿意帮助朋友，对驾驶员身份抱有憧憬。他常用摄像机记录周围的军事活动，也会关心真嗣的处境。对战斗机器的热情，让他与真嗣、东治形成特殊的同学关系。

source.description:
Kensuke Aida is an otaku, a military buff, Toji's best friend, and one of the "Other Children," Eva pilot candidates in the same class as Shinji, Toji, Rei, Asuka, and Hikari. His hobbies include camping in the mountains surrounding Tokyo-3 and playing at simulated war reenacting - by himself. Kensuke solidifies his friendship with Shinji after Shinji saves him and Toji during the fight against the fourth Angel, Shamshel. Kensuke dreams of becoming an Eva pilot and ceaselessly begs Shinji to pull strings in NERV so he can be selected as a pilot, despite Shinji telling him that he has no say in the matter. He also seems oblivious to the intense physical and psychological duress endured by Eva pilots. Nevertheless, Kensuke enjoys the privileges of being the friend of an Eva pilot; he and Toji accompany Shinji on the excursion to the UN combined naval fleet during the transportation of Unit 02. Like presumably every one of Shinji's classmates, Kensuke's mother is deceased. Like Toji, Kensuke has a crush on Misato Katsuragi. He is rarely seen without his camcorder at hand.

_Kensuke is named after a main character in the novel The Fascism of Love and Fantasies (Ai to Gensou no Fascism) by Ryu Murakami. He is also similar in appearance to the character Jean, from Hideaki Anno's earlier anime Nadia: The Secret of Blue Water._

characters.name: 冬月耕造
characters.description: 冬月耕造是《新世纪福音战士》中的角色，NERV副司令，碇源堂的得力助手，曾任大学教授，与碇唯旧识，了解EVA计划的历史，常在指挥室协助决策，性格沉稳，见证第三新东京市防卫战，参与人类补完计划，对源堂的目标有所了解。他在NERV高层中掌握大量秘密，多年来与源堂一同推动计划。过去与碇唯的关系，也影响他在关键时刻对人类未来的判断。
traits: 见证第三新东京市防卫战
对源堂的目标有所了解

source.description: Kozo Fuyutsuki is second-in-command of NERV HQ and Gendo Ikari's right hand man. As Deputy Commander of NERV, Fuyutsuki frequently takes command of situations at the base whenever Gendo is away on business. Gendo also tends to unload the more mundane work, such as town council meetings, paperwork, and the like, onto Fuyutsuki.

characters.name: 碇源堂
characters.description: 碇源堂是《新世纪福音战士》中的角色，NERV司令，碇真嗣的父亲，碇唯的丈夫，负责EVA作战与计划，常戴眼镜和手套，与儿子关系疏远，掌握人类补完计划的秘密，行事冷酷而善于算计，与SEELE有合作也有冲突，希望再次见到碇唯。他把大量资源投入EVA与补完计划，常让真嗣在缺乏解释的情况下驾驶初号机。对亡妻碇唯的执念，是他许多决定背后的关键。
traits: 掌握人类补完计划的秘密

source.description:
Gendou Ikari is the commander of NERV. He is responsible for the research done on the Evas, [Rei Ayanami](https://anilist.co/character/86), and the Human Instrumentality Project. He is the father of the Third Children, [Shinji Ikari](https://anilist.co/character/89), and the guardian of Rei. His original surname was Rokubungi, but he changed it to Ikari following his marriage to [Yui](https://anilist.co/character/1258). At the start of the series, he is the only person having an effective connection to Rei. As the series progresses, his unscrupulous past is revealed, as is the intensity with which he loved Yui.

~!In the original series, his maiden name is Rokubungi.!~

characters.name: 加持良治
characters.description: 加持良治是《新世纪福音战士》中的角色，NERV特别监察员，与葛城美里有旧情，曾与赤木律子同窗，在多个组织之间搜集情报，了解EVA计划的隐秘，外表随性，常种植西瓜，与碇真嗣有交流，暗中调查SEELE，为了揭开真相冒险行动。他表面上只是态度轻松的监察员，实际在复杂势力间寻找补完计划真相。与美里的关系和对真嗣的关心，也让他的选择超出单纯的情报任务。
traits: 在多个组织之间搜集情报
为了揭开真相冒险行动

source.description:
Kaji, while only being a special inspector, secretly works for SEELE investigating NERV's true intentions. During college, he had a serious relationship with [Misato](https://anilist.co/character/1259/Katsuragi-Misato), but after having long broken up, they see each other again on the UN fleet ferrying Unit 02 and its pilot, [Asuka Langley Soryu](https://anilist.co/character/94/Souryuu-Asuka-Langley), to Japan. 

~!After he returns to NERV headquarters, Kaji and Misato rekindle their romance following a period of teasing and insults, when Misato confesses that she broke up with him because she realized that Kaji reminded her of her father. He is eventually shot by an unnamed assailant, described as "a third party working either for SEELE or for NERV's Intelligence Division" in the episode Film-book. In the manga, it is Commander Ikari who personally kills Kaji.!~

characters.name: 渚薰
characters.description: 渚薰是《新世纪福音战士》中的角色，被称为第五适格者，与碇真嗣相识，真实身份是第十七使徒，能够操控AT力场，外表是白发少年，性格温柔神秘，短时间内赢得真嗣信任，与SEELE有关，对人类的存在抱有兴趣，其决定深刻影响真嗣。他在真嗣孤独时出现，给予罕见的理解与亲近。真实身份暴露后，真嗣必须面对无法回避的选择，两人的短暂相遇成为重要转折。
traits: 真实身份是第十七使徒
短时间内赢得真嗣信任
对人类的存在抱有兴趣

source.description: ~!Kaworu Nagisa is both the 17th Angel and the Fifth Child. Although classified as an Angel, Kaworu is similar to Rei Ayanami in being a Seed of Life that inhabits a human body. Despite his human form, Kaworu does not consider himself to be human, since he refers to humans as "the Lilin".!~

characters.name: 岸边
characters.description: 岸边是《电锯人》中的角色，公安对魔特异课成员，资深恶魔猎人，负责训练淀治和帕瓦，常带着酒壶，脸上有伤疤，拥有丰富实战经验，与光熙有旧识，对玛奇玛保持警惕，战斗时动作果断，希望年轻猎人能活下去。他用极其严厉的方式训练淀治与帕瓦，让两人理解猎魔工作随时可能丧命。看似冷酷的态度背后，他始终关注公安内部的危险。
traits: 希望年轻猎人能活下去

source.description:
__Height:__ 194 cm
__Devil Contracts:__ ~!Claw Devil, Knife Devil, Needle Devil!~

A Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 1. ~!After the assault on the Special Divisions, he became captain of the Special Division 4.!~

Kishibe is a grizzled man with scraggly facial hair and a stitched scar running across his left cheek from his mouth. He normally wears the standard Public Safety devil hunter uniform with a large overcoat. He has two piercings on his left ear, and one on his right ear. He is often seen with a hip flask which he frequently drinks from. Kishibe is a stoic, straightforward individual. Due to his immense strength and skill, he often undertakes his work with a calm formality, displaying little emotion as he does so. Though he tends to speak in a relaxed, polite manner, his actions often showcase an immense brutality garnered through many years of Devil Hunting. Though he sometimes expresses emotions such as surprise and sadness at certain events, his face and voice remain entirely neutral. Kishibe has been hunting devils for a long time, making him somewhat insane. He espouses a belief that the most fearsome devil hunters to devils isn't the brave or the strong, but the craziest as they are the ones without fear. He admits that he enjoys booze, women and killing devils.

~!He is the former partner of [Quanxi](https://anilist.co/character/162123/Quanxi).!~

characters.name: 东山小红
characters.description: 东山小红是《电锯人》中的角色，公安恶魔猎人，早川秋的同僚，行动时常显得紧张，擅长近身战斗，家中经济压力较大，被迫在危险职业中谋生，曾参与永远恶魔事件，对同伴死亡感到恐惧，与荒井弘和关系较近，面对危机仍能爆发实力。她平时容易惊慌，战斗开始时却能展现敏捷和判断力。恶魔猎人的高死亡风险使她不断想要逃离，但现实压力又让她难以选择。
traits: 被迫在危险职业中谋生
面对危机仍能爆发实力

source.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

A Public Safety Devil Hunter, she is a new recruit working under [Makima](https://anilist.co/character/137080/Makima) as a member of Tokyo Special Division 4. She is partnered with [Hirokazu Arai](https://anilist.co/character/174263).

She is not very courageous and gets scared easily by devils. Kobeni is shown to easily crack under pressure and break into tears during serious moments. Even though Kobeni is timid, she is pretty talented as a devil hunter. When Kobeni gets into action, she has proven to be cool-headed and efficient in battle, only breaking down in a panic once the fighting is over. Kobeni chooses to keep her devil contract a secret.

characters.name: 天使恶魔
characters.description: 天使恶魔是《电锯人》中的角色，公安对魔特异课成员，是具有人形的恶魔，背后长有翅膀，能够吸取接触者寿命，可把寿命转化为武器，常与早川秋一同行动，性格懒散，对人类没有普遍敌意，不喜欢直接伤害别人，身世与玛奇玛有关。他拥有强大的能力，却因触碰会夺走寿命而与他人保持距离。与秋相处后，他逐渐展现出对同伴的关心，也显露被操纵的过去。

source.description:
__Height:__ 155 cm

Angel Devil is a devil who embodies the fear of angels, and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

The Angel Devil is a unique case among devils having virtually no hostility towards humans. He dislikes being ordered around and doesn't seem inclined towards combat. His extreme laziness holds him back from being a strong fighter and he often refuses to work, even claiming to prefer dying to working.

characters.name: 比姆
characters.description: 比姆是《电锯人》中的角色，鲨鱼魔人，公安对魔特异课成员，能够在地面像游泳般移动，可以化为鲨鱼形态，非常崇拜电锯人，称呼淀治为电锯大人，与淀治并肩作战，行动方式莽撞，拥有锋利牙齿，在对抗恶魔时充当突击力量。他对电锯人有近乎狂热的忠诚，见到淀治后主动跟随。凭借能穿过地面的能力，他在追逐和战斗中常承担意想不到的移动任务。
traits: 能够在地面像游泳般移动
在对抗恶魔时充当突击力量

source.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (With fin: 176 cm)

He is a Shark Fiend and a Public Safety Devil Hunter from Special Division 4.

Beam is very eccentric. He often goes along with [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji)'s plans no matter how crazy they are due to having a lot of respect for the [Chainsaw Devil](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita).

characters.name: 武士刀
characters.description: 武士刀是《电锯人》中的角色，与淀治对立的混合体，与刀之恶魔融合，手臂与头部可化为刀刃，祖父曾与淀治有恩怨，与泽渡茜合作，袭击公安恶魔猎人，拥有快速斩击能力，被称作刀男，对淀治怀有强烈仇恨，是公安篇重要敌人。他因祖父的死把矛头指向淀治，联合泽渡茜袭击公安。作为混合体，他能以刀刃化身快速战斗，与电锯形态的淀治正面交锋。
traits: 手臂与头部可化为刀刃

source.description: Samurai Sword is a human-devil hybrid who merged with the Katana Devil. His [grandfather](https://anilist.co/character/289198/Yakuza) was killed by [Denji](https://anilist.co/character/130102/Denji) when they initially fused with [Pochita](https://anilist.co/character/170266/Pochita), and because of that, he affiliated with the [Gun Devil](https://anilist.co/character/208942/Juu-no-Akuma) to get revenge on Denji. He works alongside [Akane Sawatari](https://anilist.co/character/174264/Akane-Sawatari) and other fellow members of the Yakuza.

characters.name: 波奇塔
characters.description: 波奇塔是《电锯人》中的角色，电锯恶魔，外形像橙色小狗，头部伸出电锯刀刃，与淀治一起生活，曾在淀治濒死时救他，与淀治融合成为心脏，希望淀治实现平凡梦想，性格温顺，能听懂淀治的话，是电锯人力量的来源。他与孤独的淀治相依为命，共同做猎魔工作偿还债务。后来他把心脏交给淀治，要求对方继续向自己讲述梦想，两人的约定贯穿故事。
nicknames: Chainsaw no Akuma (チェンソーの悪魔)
traits: 希望淀治实现平凡梦想

name_alternative: Chainsaw no Akuma (チェンソーの悪魔)
source.description: Pochita appears to be a small red canine with a chainsaw like appendage protruding from the center of his head. Handles emerge from his body allowing him to be wielded like a chainsaw and his short tail is in the shape of a chainsaw's pull cord. Unlike most devils, Pochita communicated solely through barks and whines like an actual dog.

titles: วันพันช์แมน

characters.name: 音速的索尼克
characters.description: 音速的索尼克是《一拳超人》中的角色，自称埼玉的宿敌，受过忍者训练，速度极快，擅长使用忍具和刀，曾担任保镖，与埼玉多次交手，性格自负，不肯承认实力差距，常以黑色服装行动，一心想要打败埼玉。他初次败给埼玉后便执着于复仇，反复设计新的挑战。尽管实力出众，每次遭遇埼玉都不得不面对出乎意料的结果。

source.description:
__Height:__ 174 cm
__Race:__ Human
__Location:__ Z-City
__Abilities:__ Superhuman Speed and Agility
__Weapons:__ Ninja equipment
__Occupation:__ Bodyguard (former, now a villain)
__Affiliation:__ Mr. Monier (former)


Sonic is a villain in the series, first appearing as a bodyguard hired by Mr. Monier. He views [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama) as his eternal rival.

Sonic is a villain who, despite his normally calm appearance, loves fighting strong opponents as shown by when he gets a "child-like smile" on his face when he first meets Saitama and has two of his attacks blocked, earlier calling this his "bad habit." He seems to be very quick to act as he attacks Saitama on their first meeting without letting him explain the situation.

characters.name: 邦古
characters.description: 邦古是《一拳超人》中的角色，英雄名银色獠牙，S级英雄，流水岩碎拳宗师，经营武术道场，曾指导饿狼，身材瘦小但实力强大，与兄长邦普相识，关心弟子的成长，尊重埼玉的力量，在怪人危机中出战。他是经验丰富的武术家，以柔韧的拳法化解对手攻击。饿狼偏离道路后，他始终感到责任重大，也努力阻止更严重的破坏。

source.description:
__Height:__ 165 cm (5'5")
__Race:__ Human  
__Occupation:__ Superhero 
__Level:__ S-Class 
__Rank:__ 3 
__Affiliation:__ Heroes Association

 Bang is an S-Class, rank 3, superhero for the Heroes Association, settled in Z-City. Bang owns a dojo passed down from generations, and uses the fighting style the Rock-Smashing Water Stream Fist.   

__Abilities:__ Bang being in the top 3 of the S-Class ranking, he is acknowledged by the public and heroes to be a strong fighter. Not much is known about Bang's abilities other than that he uses a martial art called "Rock-Smashing Water Stream Fist".

characters.name: 地狱的吹雪
characters.description: 地狱的吹雪是《一拳超人》中的角色，B级英雄首位，吹雪组首领，战栗的龙卷的妹妹，拥有念动力，身穿深色礼服，擅长组织团队，曾试图招揽埼玉，在姐姐面前承受压力，性格要强，逐渐理解伙伴合作的重要。她最初依靠团队与等级制度巩固地位，遇到埼玉后对自己的目标产生变化。与龙卷的姐妹关系，也让她始终想证明自己的能力。
nicknames: Jigoku no Fubuki (地獄のフブキ)
traits: 逐渐理解伙伴合作的重要

name_alternative: Jigoku no Fubuki (地獄のフブキ)
source.description: __Race:__ Human __Occupation:__ Superhero __Height:__ 167 cm (5'5¾") __Level:__ B-Class Rank 1 __Affiliation:__ Hero Association __Family:__ Tatsumaki (sister) __Abilities:__ Psychokinesis Fubuki, also known by her hero alias Blizzard of Hell, is the B-Class Rank 1 professional hero of the Hero Association. She is an esper, the younger sister of Tatsumaki, and the leader of the Blizzard Group, a B-Class hero faction. She and her sister are known as the Psychic Sisters. Fubuki is currently trying to recruit [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama) into her group. She's also a self-declared member of the Saitama Group.

characters.name: 帝王
characters.description: 帝王是《一拳超人》中的角色，S级英雄，被称为地表最强的男人，脸上有明显疤痕，实际没有超人战斗能力，喜欢电子游戏，与埼玉成为朋友，紧张时心跳声被称作帝王引擎，常被误认作击败怪人的英雄，内心胆小，努力面对外界对自己的期待。他强大的名声来自一连串误会，真正遇到怪人时常感到恐惧。与埼玉成为朋友后，他终于能向人坦言自己的秘密。
traits: 被称为地表最强的男人
实际没有超人战斗能力
紧张时心跳声被称作帝王引擎
常被误认作击败怪人的英雄
努力面对外界对自己的期待

source.description:
__Race:__ Human  __Occupation:__ Superhero 
__Level:__ S-Class; Rank 7
__Affiliation:__ The Heroes Association

Despite not being the highest ranked hero of the Heroes Association, he is considered to be the most powerful man on Earth, and it is due to this strength that he receives praise and respect from fellow heroes. His strength is so feared that criminals and mysterious beings will surrender before having to fight him. Appearance: King has slightly long, blonde, brushed back hair along with three long scars on the left side of his face. He wears a turtleneck sweater, has sunken cheeks, a defined jawline and a squarish chin. Notably, a loud drumming sound may be heard in his proximity. The King Engine is a rumbling sound that others claim occurs when King readies for battle or when he is generally serious having an intimidating effect on his opponents. ~! In actuality, it is simply the sound of King's heartbeat which, when he is frightened, is so loud that it can be heard outside his body, but because of King's intimidating reputation people mistake it for bloodlust. King is able to appear to remain calm in threatening situations as well as put out an extremely threatening aura. Despite the intimidating personality King projects, he is actually a coward and an otaku. He has been shown to get very excited about buying a dating game. Saitama saved his life many times, but always end up getting all the credits that was supposed to be for the latter. With this misunderstanding, he came to be known as "the strongest man on earth". He got his scars from the Octopus Claw man. !~

characters.name: 金属球棒
characters.description: 金属球棒是《一拳超人》中的角色，S级英雄，使用金属球棒战斗，本名巴德，非常疼爱妹妹善子，受到打击后斗志提升，战斗方式直接，脾气急躁，曾与饿狼交手，重视家人，在怪人袭击中积极行动。他靠惊人的耐力和不断高涨的斗志与强敌交战，常在看似不利时继续站起。对妹妹的疼爱，也让他的粗犷外表有温柔的一面。
traits: 在怪人袭击中积极行动

source.description: Bad (バッド, Baddo), also known by his hero alias Metal Bat (金属バット, Kinzoku Batto), is the S-Class Rank 15 professional hero for the Hero Association. Metal Bat is a young man with black hair styled in a pompadour, and dark eyes that emphasize his hot temper. Metal Bat has a great deal of confidence in himself, stating that he did not care whether a threat is a Demon or Dragon level. Like [Saitama](https://anilist.co/character/73935/Saitama), he doesn't care about his rank, and accidentally kills his enemies faster than he intended.

characters.name: 波罗斯
characters.description: 波罗斯是《一拳超人》中的角色，暗黑盗贼团首领，来自宇宙，拥有压倒性力量，率领飞船袭击地球，渴望遇见强大对手，能够释放巨大能量，与埼玉展开战斗，身体具有再生能力，战斗时会解除力量限制，是第一季重要敌人。他因长期找不到值得认真作战的对手而来到地球。与埼玉的对决让他终于体验全力战斗，也认识到双方力量之间仍存在差距。
traits: 战斗时会解除力量限制

source.description:
__Race:__ Alien
__Height:__ 240 cm (7'10½")
__Occupation__: Space Pirate
__Disaster Level:__ Dragon (or higher)

Boros was the leader of the Dark Matter Thieves, a group of alien invaders responsible for the destruction of A-City. Like Saitama, Boros faced a self-imposed existential crisis, having become so powerful that no battle thrilled him.

~!Boros was the first on-screen opponent of Saitama that survived after getting punched, much to the hero's surprise. In fact, he is the very first of Saitama's opponents that took more than one punch to kill; Saitama even considered him to be the strongest opponent he had faced so far.!~

characters.name: 深海王
characters.description: 深海王是《一拳超人》中的角色，深海族首领，从海中来到陆地，在雨中实力增强，外形庞大，袭击避难所，与多名英雄交战，曾击败无证骑士，性格残暴，自认为地表生物的支配者，最终与埼玉交手。他在城市中连续击败英雄，让避难民众陷入恐惧。无证骑士即使实力悬殊仍挺身而出，随后埼玉赶到结束战斗。
traits: 自认为地表生物的支配者

source.description: The Deep Sea King (深海王, Shinkaiō) ruled over the Seafolk as their king, and claimed the deep sea as his own. The Deep Sea King is a rather sadistic individual, who enjoys causing pain to others and starting fights. He is determined to take the surface world for himself to rule. He regards people as little more than food and has no qualms about treating them as such. He is also very arrogant and prideful, considering himself to be better than everyone and stating that he stands at the very top of the pyramid of all living organisms on the planet.

anime.anime_title: 辉夜大小姐想让我告白

characters.name: 早坂爱
characters.description: 早坂爱是《辉夜大小姐想让我告白》中的角色，四宫辉夜的随从，秀知院学园学生，长期照料辉夜生活，擅长变换身份与形象，能收集校内情报，与辉夜关系复杂而亲密，常帮助她处理恋爱烦恼，行动能力出色，对自由生活有所向往，在四宫家与学校之间承担多重身份。她表面上能从容完成各种任务，长期侍奉四宫家却让她很难表达自己的愿望。与辉夜共同成长的经历，使两人既像主仆也像朋友。

source.description:
Ai Hayasaka is a second-year student at Shuchiin Academy and a valet of the Shinomiya family. She is a member of the Hayasaka family, who have served the Shinomiya family for generations, gaining their trust.

Having been personally assigned to enter Shuchiin Academy with her, Ai supports [Kaguya Shinomiya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) in her high school life and has been a part of Kaguya's life for ten years. Because of their close relationship, Ai is one of the few people around to which Kaguya's amiability is not an act.

Even if she demonstrates maturity as a valet, Ai still has the concerns of a young girl, such as caring to be in fashion and going out with friends, even if she does not have much time for herself due to work.

Ai helps Kaguya with the struggles about her feelings for [Shirogane](https://anilist.co/character/121101).

~!She later leaves her job as a maid to Kaguya but still continues her friendship.!~

~!In the Doujin-ban universe, she starts dating and later gets engaged to Shirogane!~

characters.name: 白银圭
characters.description: 白银圭是《辉夜大小姐想让我告白》中的角色，白银御行的妹妹，秀知院学园中等部学生，担任学生会相关职务，与父亲和兄长同住，性格认真，会关心家中经济，与四宫辉夜相识，常对兄长的举止感到困扰，外表冷静，在家庭日常中展现体贴。她在兄长面前常摆出冷淡态度，实际非常关心家人。家庭经济和父亲的生活方式让她比同龄人更早学会考虑现实问题。
traits: 秀知院学园中等部学生
常对兄长的举止感到困扰
在家庭日常中展现体贴

source.description:
Kei Shirogane is [Miyuki Shirogane's](https://anilist.co/character/121101) little sister. She attends Shuchiin middle school and is the treasurer for the middle school student council.

She is a hard worker just like her brother and can be very prideful at times. She also inherited his sense of righteousness and hates it when someone doesn't do the right thing in a given situation. Like her brother, she likes helping out those who are in trouble even if it means going out of her way to do it. Since she grew up in a family that places emphasis on saving money, she normally carries coupons and works hard for the things she wants to buy. 

She developed a prickly attitude towards her brother due to his over protectiveness. She's also entered a rebellious phase and due to her pride and she cannot get herself to have a lighthearted conversation with Miyuki, leading into the similar mind games that Miyuki and [Kaguya](https://anilist.co/character/120649) play against each other, but her objective is to talk to Miyuki without making it look like she has a brother complex. She rarely speaks and most of the time it is only when she exchanges formalities at school or when she hurls abuses at her brother.

characters.name: 柏木渚
characters.description: 柏木渚是《辉夜大小姐想让我告白》中的角色，秀知院学园学生，与四宫辉夜同年级，田沼翼的女友，曾向辉夜咨询恋爱问题，与四条真妃是好友，性格温柔，在学校里有较高人气，与学生会成员有来往，恋爱经历常成为话题，家庭背景优裕。她最初因恋爱烦恼向辉夜求助，之后与田沼翼的关系不断发展。真妃对翼的感情让三人的友情与恋情变得微妙。
traits: 曾向辉夜咨询恋爱问题

characters.name: 白银父亲
characters.description: 白银父亲是《辉夜大小姐想让我告白》中的角色，白银御行与白银圭的父亲，曾经营公司，公司倒闭后经济拮据，与妻子分居，性格戏剧化，常调侃儿女，会做各种临时工作，非常关心孩子，与四宫辉夜有过接触，在家庭困境中保持乐观。他看起来常说些不着边际的话，却一直努力维持家庭生活。御行和圭虽然会被他的举止弄得尴尬，也知道父亲始终关心他们。

characters.description: 笛口雏实是《东京喰种》中的角色，年幼的喰种，笛口凉子的女儿，与金木研和董香相识，曾在安定区得到照顾，拥有敏锐感官，失去双亲后受到保护，性格温柔，擅长阅读，后来逐渐学会保护他人，与搜查官的冲突改变她的生活。她原本与母亲平静生活，家人遭遇搜查官追捕后被迫面对残酷现实。金木与董香给予她支持，使她在悲伤中慢慢成长。

Hinami is initially quite shy, but when she opens up, she is cheerful and earnest. [Ken](https://anilist.co/character/87275/Kaneki-Ken) helps her learn kanji, as she cannot attend school, and is very eager to learn. She is living together with [Touka Kirishima](https://anilist.co/character/87277/Kirishima-Touka).

characters.name: 亚门钢太朗
characters.description: 亚门钢太朗是《东京喰种》中的角色，CCG喰种搜查官，曾与真户吴绪搭档，坚定相信保护人类的职责，身材高大，使用昆克战斗，与金木研多次交手，对搜查官身份有自觉，不断反思喰种与人类的界线，经历重大身体变化，与真户晓关系密切。他最初把喰种视为必须消灭的对象，和金木的数次遭遇却不断冲击这种看法。调查过程中，他也逐渐认识到双方世界都存在复杂的人。

__Height:__ 191 cm (6'3")

A first class police investigator who investigates Ghouls, also known as a Dove. He comes to the 20th ward with his mentor, [Mado Kureo](https://anilist.co/character/88423), to investigate Ghoul incidents in the area. He has a strong sense of justice, fervently believing it is the right and moral thing to do to exterminate the Ghouls. He hunts the Ghouls in order to prevent more human children from becoming orphaned like himself, and he often works after hours to achieve his goals.

He wields a "Quinque" (a weapon made from the "Kagune" of a Ghoul) that has the appearance of a pole-arm with a large cylindrical bludgeon at the end.

characters.description: 西尾锦是《东京喰种》中的角色，就读上井大学，是喰种，与西野贵未交往，早期与金木研冲突，后来在安定区工作，擅长近身战斗，拥有尾赫，性格尖刻，十分重视贵未，逐渐与金木一方合作。他初登场时对其他喰种充满警惕，甚至与金木发生激烈冲突。贵未的存在改变了他的选择，也让他在安定区找到新的位置。

characters.name: 雾岛绚都
characters.description: 雾岛绚都是《东京喰种》中的角色，雾岛董香的弟弟，是喰种，曾加入青桐树，拥有羽赫，行动方式激进，与姐姐关系紧张，童年失去父母庇护，擅长高速攻击，逐渐承担组织任务，内心仍关心董香。他走上与姐姐不同的道路，以强硬手段对抗人类搜查官。两人表面冲突激烈，彼此的牵挂却始终没有消失。

Shuu Tsukiyama was the infamous Gourmet ghoul of the 20th ward. He was a fourth-year student studying Social Welfare at the Department of Human Sciences at Seinan Gakuin University. He comes from the extremely wealthy and influential Tsukiyama family which his father, Mirumo Tsukiyama was the head of. Tsukiyama himself became the head of his family after the Tsukiyama Family Extermination Operation. He was also a member of the Ghoul Restaurant, known as MM until he betrayed them.

He joined Kaneki's group with the hidden intention of eating Ken Kaneki, obsessed with his scent and taste but eventually came to genuinely care for Kaneki. Two years later, his severe depression and anorexia after Kaneki's apparent demise left him emaciated and required constant care from his family servants. After finding out Kaneki was alive and meeting him, he recovers, being able to walk and eat on his own as well as take measures to help Kaneki regain his memories.

__Relatives:__ [Kogoro Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1746/Kogoro-Mouri) (husband), [Ran Mouri](https://anilist.co/character/1748/Ran-Mouri) (daughter), Mr. Kisaki (father)
__Occupation:__ Lawyer

Her real name is Eri Mouri. She began to use her maiden name again after she began living separately from her husband Kogoro Mouri. She also runs her law practice under her maiden name. In a recent hospitalization, her name was displayed as "Eri Mouri" on the door. She has one daughter, Ran Mouri. Eri has advanced skills in Judo, taught to her by Kogoro. 

The separately-living wife of Kogoro Mouri, Eri is a lawyer who often gets tangled in Kogoro's cases, usually serving as an extra pair of eyes when it becomes time to investigate a crime. Although she does not like Kogoro's attitude and personality _(especially his drinking and skirt-chasing habits),_ she still deeply loves and cares for him, often testing him to see if he still cares about her as well. 

Her personality suits her occupation as a lawyer. She is often very questioning, and gets herself involved in the investigation of cases along with Kogoro, much to his chagrin. She has a cat, a Russian Blue named "Goro," whom she cares for very deeply; in fact, Goro's name comes from "KoGORO" of Kogoro Mouri, since to her the cat and Kogoro both act very similar in some ways. Eri is also very close friends with her secretary, [Midori Kuriyama.](https://anilist.co/character/30371/Midori-Kuriyama)
